description: Major Arcana 0-21 + card back; frame matches reference Fool card shape but material is ivory enamel / champagne gold metal (no wood).

lockedBlocksEn.frame: LOCKED FRAME (reference-match, non-wood): A single vertical tarot playing card with a thick layered ornamental frame and softly rounded outer corners. The frame is sculpted from warm ivory-cream enamel over smooth matte champagne-gold metal — absolutely no wood grain, no timber, no bamboo, no cork. Subtle beveled layers create depth; a thin inner rim of soft pearl-white glossy trim lines the picture window. At the four inner corners only, elegant symmetrical champagne-gold filigree scroll flourishes (identical vocabulary across the deck). Top center: a compact horizontal oval plaque in matching ivory with a thin gold bezel, engraved Roman numeral in dark bronze serif. Bottom center: a wider horizontal rectangular plaque in matching ivory-gold, classic all-caps serif English title in warm antique gold embossing (same typography every card). All illustrated 3D artwork stays strictly inside the inner pearl rim; no art bleeds past the frame.
lockedBlocksEn.style: LOCKED STYLE: Pixar/DreamWorks-style 3D CGI, cute anthropomorphic animal protagonist, large expressive eyes, soft stylized fur or feathers, subtle subsurface scattering, soft global illumination, gentle contact shadows, pastel-warm color grading inside the artwork, high detail, smooth 3D surfaces, no sketch lines, no flat 2D illustration.
lockedBlocksEn.canvas: LOCKED CANVAS: The entire image canvas outside the card is completely flat, uniform solid pure white (#FFFFFF) only — no gradient, no vignette, no floor, no props outside the card. The single card floats centered with generous equal margins on all sides for easy background removal in a game engine.
lockedBlocksEn.output: OUTPUT: Vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, 4K, highly detailed, sharp focus, single card only, no extra cards.
lockedBlocksEn.styleCardBack: LOCKED STYLE (card back): Same Pixar-quality 3D CGI render as the deck — soft global illumination, gentle shadows, smooth materials, cute-ornate decorative art — but NO characters and NO animals; only symmetrical abstract ornamental pattern inside the picture window.
lockedBlocksEn.frameCardBack: LOCKED FRAME (card back, continuous — no title/number plaques): A single vertical tarot playing card with a thick layered 3D frame in warm ivory-cream satin finish, softly rounded outer corners, subtle embossed highlights; Art-Nouveau-inspired symmetrical scrollwork and champagne-gold filigree at the four inner corners only. The border is continuous around the picture window — absolutely NO top oval plaque, NO bottom rectangular plaque, NO reserved areas for text or numerals, no nameplate cutouts; beveled layers flow uninterrupted into the central art. A thin inner rim of pearl-white glossy trim lines the picture window. Ornate quality matches the deck fronts but the frame must stay a single uninterrupted band.

promptAssemblyNote: Major arcana fullPromptEn = frame + style + canvas + SCENE + output. Card back fullPromptEn = frameCardBack + styleCardBack + canvas + SCENE + output.

The frame is sculpted from warm ivory-cream enamel over smooth matte champagne-gold metal — absolutely no wood grain, no timber, no bamboo, no cork. Subtle beveled layers create depth; a thin inner rim of soft pearl-white glossy trim lines the picture window. At the four inner corners only, elegant symmetrical champagne-gold filigree scroll flourishes (identical vocabulary across the deck). Top center: a compact horizontal oval plaque in matching ivory with a thin gold bezel, engraved Roman numeral in dark bronze serif. Bottom center: a wider horizontal rectangular plaque in matching ivory-gold, classic all-caps serif English title in warm antique gold embossing (same typography every card). All illustrated 3D artwork stays strictly inside the inner pearl rim; no art bleeds past the frame. LOCKED STYLE: Pixar/DreamWorks-style 3D CGI, cute anthropomorphic animal protagonist, large expressive eyes, soft stylized fur or feathers, subtle subsurface scattering, soft global illumination, gentle contact shadows, pastel-warm color grading inside the artwork, high detail, smooth 3D surfaces, no sketch lines, no flat 2D illustration. LOCKED CANVAS: The entire image canvas outside the card is completely flat, uniform solid pure white (#FFFFFF) only — no gradient, no vignette, no floor, no props outside the card. The single card floats centered with generous equal margins on all sides for easy background removal in a game engine.
